private.analysis_stage_parameter_keys.body:
select case when jsonb_typeof(p_value)='object' then
    (select array_agg(k order by k) from jsonb_object_keys(p_value) k)
      is not distinct from (select array_agg(k order by k) from unnest(p_keys) k)
    else false end;

private.analysis_stage_integer.body:
select case when jsonb_typeof(p_value)='number' then
    (p_value #>> '{}')::numeric between -2147483648 and 2147483647
      and (p_value #>> '{}')::numeric=trunc((p_value #>> '{}')::numeric)
    else false end;

private.evidence_integer.body:
select case when jsonb_typeof(p_value) = 'number' then
    (p_value #>> '{}')::numeric between p_min and p_max and
    trunc((p_value #>> '{}')::numeric) = (p_value #>> '{}')::numeric
  else false end;

private.evidence_number.body: select case when jsonb_typeof(p_value) = 'number' then (p_value #>> '{}')::numeric between p_min and p_max else false end;
